phase_name: Full gate set, pre-existing specs, and redeploy

objectives.description: Run pre-existing merge_spec.lua and manifest_spec.lua in full
Redeploy host .claude/ tree from the source store (bounded-wait idiom)
Scoped gate discharge per Batch Gate Deferral: verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 21,8
Re-run suite_selection_select over every touched file, close Phase 3 hypothesis
Fix shellcheck SC2088 finding introduced by the new ~/-anchored test case

approaches_tried.approach: Arm a Monitor and let the turn end to await the gate-run notification
approaches_tried.reason: The first --only-gate 21,8 attempt was launched via a plain foreground Bash call that the harness auto-backgrounded after ~180s (well under both my own --timeout argument and the Bash tool's stated ceiling); a Monitor armed afterward to watch it reported the underlying process had been terminated (exit 143, the outer `timeout 500` wrapper firing) before gate 8's own run-all.sh finished, under heavy concurrent system load from sibling /orchestrate batch tasks. Re-run directly via nohup + captured PID + a REPEATED bounded kill-0 wait loop (three sequential ~170s polls within the same turn, never ending the turn on an unresolved wait) is what produced the real result.

deviations.description: Run the complete gate set: bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh
deviations.reason: The dispatch file's own Batch Gate Deferral directive names this exact final phase and requires discharging it against a scoped --only-gate invocation instead of the unqualified aggregator, with the full battery run once for the whole /orchestrate batch. Ran --only-gate 21,8 at full depth (no --skip-slow, no suite narrowing within those two gates) rather than the bare aggregator.

notes: Gate 21 (lint-hook-registration-paths.sh) PASSES cleanly. Gate 8 (tests/run-all.sh) reports FAIL at the verify-deploy.sh wrapper level, but run-all.sh's OWN verdict is '179 passed, 5 failed (5 expected, 0 NEW), 2 skipped, 186 total' -- all five failing suites are pre-existing, independently-tracked EXPECTED failures (test-double-loading-check.sh, test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh [gate10 60s timeout under concurrent load], test-lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh, test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh), none touching hook registrations or this task's files; 0 NEW confirms this task caused none of them. test-lint-hook-registration-paths.sh itself (this task's own suite) PASSES in that same run. A shellcheck SC2088 false-positive (two inline disable comments needed on the new ~/-anchored test case) was found and fixed during this phase's own full redeploy-plus-gate pass.
